correctness.rationale: The Peter–Weyl and Clebsch–Gordan reduction gives the exact coefficients c_(y-1)=a_y(1+b R_y). The derivative P(u,q) has exactly one relevant positive crossing for q>0 and none for -1<q<=0; the sextic T_y has exactly one positive root for each integer y>=2 by its coefficients and Descartes sign rule. These identities and strict unimodality prove every ordered transition without omission. Finite missing Fourier blocks imply strict positive definiteness by non-atomic Haar uniqueness, while RKHS universality is equivalent to all Fourier blocks present. All hypotheses and asymptotic boundaries are explicit. A standalone exact-rational supplementary checker passed 3748 tests; symbolic identities independently simplified within the same review.
